ponto.title: Timekeeping operation
ponto.subtitle: The daily path: register, review the mirror and close the period.
ponto.flowStep1: Cards — keep employees and schedules up to date.
ponto.flowStep2: Mirror — review and adjust the period punches.
ponto.flowStep3: Period close — recalculate, approve and lock the month.
ponto.cardCardsDesc: Employee records, IDs and schedules. Then send to the clock under Communication.
ponto.cardMirrorDesc: Review punches, absences and hours per day. Adjust before closing.
ponto.cardApuracaoDesc: Recalculate, approve and lock the period to release payroll and reports.
ponto.commHint: Need to fetch or send data to the clock? Go to Clock communication.

apuracao.title: Period close
apuracao.subtitle: Close the month: recalculate, review in the mirror, approve and lock.
apuracao.stepFlow: Recalculate → Review in mirror → Approve → Lock
apuracao.recalcPartial: {{count}} day(s) recalculated; {{failed}} failed. Check the mirror and retry the failing cases.
apuracao.recalcFailed: Could not recalculate the period. Try again or check that the month is not locked.
apuracao.confirmRecalc: Recalculate period {{period}} ({{range}}) for all employees? Days with manual adjustments will be kept.
apuracao.errNoEmployees: No eligible employees to recalculate for this period.
apuracao.lockedNote: Period locked — punches cannot be edited or recalculated.
apuracao.statusFailed: Could not change the period status.
apuracao.loadFailed: Could not load the period. Refresh the page and try again.
apuracao.loadReadinessFailed: Period loaded, but the approval summary failed. You can still recalculate.
apuracao.errPeriodLocked: This period is locked. Reopen it (if allowed) before recalculating.
apuracao.errConfig: Data service unavailable. Check your connection and try again.
apuracao.errNoOrg: Organization not found in this session. Sign out and sign in again.
apuracao.errPermission: You do not have permission for this action. Ask an admin or try again.
apuracao.statusHintOPEN: Period open: recalculate and review the mirror before approving.
apuracao.statusHintIN_REVIEW: In review: check pending items in the mirror and approve when ready.
apuracao.statusHintAPPROVED: Approved: generate reports/payroll or lock to close the period.
apuracao.statusHintLOCKED: Locked: period closed. Use reports for consultation.
apuracao.confirmLock: Lock period {{period}}? After locking it cannot be edited.
apuracao.onlyAdminHr: Only ADMIN/HR can close the period.

comunicacao.title: Clock communication
comunicacao.subtitle: Fetch punches and send records to the time clock — deliberate actions, separate from records.
comunicacao.collectDesc: Fetches punches recorded on the clock and imports them into the mirror.
comunicacao.sendDesc: Sends employees and updated records to the clock.
comunicacao.syncAllDesc: Sends records and collects punches in a single operation.
comunicacao.statusDesc: Track the latest punch collect (manual or scheduled) and recent history. Scheduled runs also show up here.
comunicacao.serviceOnline: Online — ready to collect and send.
comunicacao.serviceBusy: Busy — a sync is already running.
comunicacao.lastPunchEmpty: No punch collect recorded on the server yet.
comunicacao.historyEmpty: No history yet. After the next manual or scheduled collect, results appear here.
comunicacao.busy: A sync is already in progress.
comunicacao.serviceDown: dmprep-sync service is unreachable on the server (.245:3099). It should restart automatically in a few seconds — retry. If it persists, run start-rh.ps1 or Ensure-DmprepSync.ps1.
comunicacao.noResultYet: No action run in this session.
comunicacao.advancedDesc: Supervisors, employer data and policies live under Organization → System.
comunicacao.note: Editing a card does not send anything to the clock automatically. Use this screen to send or collect.
comunicacao.onlyAdmin: Only ADMIN can talk to the clock.
